items.description: When identical charges repel each other but are confined to the surface of a sphere, they seek the arrangement with the lowest possible energy. Nitobe came to realize the answer was the samurai ethics he had grown up with. He described them through seven virtues: rectitude, courage, benevolence, politeness, veracity, honor and loyalty.
